# 发动机类型与主要指标

_Engine Configurations & Performance Measures_

涡喷、涡扇、涡桨和涡轴的能量输出形式不同。比较方案时，应先说明飞行任务和工况，再看推力或轴功率、耗油率、重量及安装约束。

_Turbojets, turbofans, turboprops and turboshafts deliver useful output in different forms. Define the mission and operating conditions before comparing thrust or shaft power, fuel consumption, mass and installation constraints._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 区分净推力、轴功率与推进效率，避免把不同输出形式直接放在同一数值表里。

_Distinguish net thrust, shaft power and propulsive efficiency before comparing different output forms._

- 整理涵道比、总压比、涡轮进口温度等术语，并记录其适用的发动机构型。

_Record terms such as bypass ratio, overall pressure ratio and turbine inlet temperature together with the engine configuration._

- 阅读时把设计点与实际任务剖面分开，记录指标对应的高度、速度和工作状态。

_Separate the design point from the mission profile, and retain the altitude, speed and rating associated with every performance value._
